newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian photographer kidnapped in Chechnya.
newsitem.headline: Italian photographer kidnapped in Chechnya.

text.p: An Italian photographer has been kidnapped in the Chechen capital Grozny, the Foreign Ministry said on Monday.
It said that Mauro Galligani, 55, who worked for the news weekly Panorama, had been taken hostage on Sunday.

A statement issued by the Italian embassy in Moscow, and carried by the Italian news agency ANSA, said four armed men had stopped Galligani, Francesco Bigazzi, a correspondent for the Italian daily Il Giorno, a driver and an interpreter in the city centre and forced Galligani to leave with them.
The statement said Italian diplomats were in touch with Russian authorities and the Foreign Ministry in Rome said they were also trying to contact the kidnappers.

Moscow, which pulled out its troops last autumn after a bloody but unsuccessful two-year intervention against separatist rebels in Chechnya, refuses to countenance Chechen sovereignty. Negotiations are continuing between the two sides.
